classification_definitions.unresolved: Source evidence or mapping is insufficient; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

managed_fixture.meaning: Real temporary-root file tree and ELF-shaped bytes; status, enroll and systemctl are injected functions. No actual service/daemon is launched.

managed_storage.meaning: Production descriptor checks, snapshot/restore, atomic write/rename/sync, file lock and persisted JSON journal.

citations.function: path, secureManagedDirectory, lock, atomicManagedFile, syncManagedDirectory, removeManagedFile, installManagedBinary, readTransaction, writeTransaction

managed_install.meaning: install validates local identity before lock; reads/writes real journal/backups/binary/config/unit files; external service and daemon callbacks are faked by managed fixture.

managed_recover.meaning: recover reads persisted journal; expired transactions execute real restoration and write completed journal; unexpired journals repair real watchdog unit files while systemd is injected.

worker_proof.meaning: Tests call finishModeWithProof directly, not exported privileged worker wrapper. Eligibility uses supplied proof plus journal under real lock; orphan cleanup callback is fake and deliberately ignored.

config_predicates.meaning: Normalization, URL/secret/IP/name validation are local predicates; no Vault or manager call.

config_load.meaning: Production loader opens actual supplied pathname with O_NOFOLLOW, checks descriptor metadata, reads bounded bytes and delegates to local strict JSON and normalization.

enroll_fixture.meaning: testEnroller supplies real temporary hosts file/runtime path, fake hostname and fail-on-call Vault reader; each root replaces command runner with synthetic status/config replies. socketPath remains empty so actual daemon socket is not checked.

enroll_flow.meaning: enroll performs actual runtime-lock/hosts handling then injected daemon commands. observe/awaitDaemon/status/settingsApplied only see synthetic runner bytes in these roots.

decision_memory.meaning: recordEnrollment records a constructed failure decision into the installed in-memory Journal. No Sink/Archive or Run is provided; Query reads ring snapshot, not NATS/durable storage.

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE. Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no receipts reviewed, no Go/build/test/lint/helper execution.
Fake systemctl/status/enroll/command runners do not qualify real systemd, NetBird daemon, OCI Vault or network enrollment.
Managed ELF-shaped fixture bytes are read/verified/copied only; no fixture executable is launched. Struct-copy recovery does not qualify process restart or crash durability.
Malformed schema and local cancellation/ID/deadline obligations remain explicit even where genuine filesystem assertions coexist.
Watchdog stale-identity case uses a noncanonical ID and proves the local guard only; valid foreign-journal mismatch coverage is not inferred.
Baseline/current declarations and original assertions retained. No test/source deletion, retirement, runtime qualification, ledger/count or global completion promotion authorized.
